title: 第1534章 太白化生第1533章 那一缕剑光
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
“这就是第一祖地的天骄吗？愧是祖地孕育出来的天骄，竟然能够抹平这么多世的差距积累，真是恐怖啊！”
现场从安静中逐渐变得嘈杂，太白子的战力让很多人失神，而聂科的表现更是让人心惊。
特别是光明神庭和天命神庭的人了，这一刻他们隐约明白，为何降临在九州天下，中原天下，神话天下的域外势力会被本土势力压制了。
因为这边的本土天骄确实有些邪门。
九州天下不愧是第一祖地的核心之地啊！
难怪就连玄霄都不得不退避锋芒，来到南北天下，与他们争夺造化地盘……
宴席角落里，几位不败主神色莫名有的脸色平静，但也有的脸上出现了惊容，显然这一战让他们都不由心中泛起涟漪。
“太白子很强，虽然他只积累了四世，但他凭借着那一手剑术杀伐之力，恐怕战力比一些积累了五世的不败主还要强，但这个聂科竟然……”
有一个人开口，对这一战做出这样的点评。
人们目光望去，开口的是靖玄神子。
千月点了点头，她身后有5道身影若隐若现，每一道身影都仿佛凝结着一个道果，在这五道身影的衬托下，千月的身影愈发的朦胧可怕。
有人凭借着千月身后的五道身影做出推测，认为千月是一位五世不败主，而如今是千月的第六世。
她身后的每一道身影便代表着一世，而一旦五世合一，千月的战力将会到达一个无法想象的高度。
但也有人认为这位千月神女来历比想象的更加神秘，因为她知晓很多隐秘，简直像一部行走的古史。
因此有人推测，千月很可能不止五世不败……
战场中太白神庭的人也冲到了太白子身边，太白子的眉心有一道血痕，他的眼神黯淡，但体内生机并没有完全消失。
“不破不立，就借此斩去这副旧枷锁吧！”
太白子肉身中有声音传出。
这道声音不像是之前那般平和，而是充满着锐意锋芒。
紧接着，在众人吃惊的目光中，太白子那眉心伤口处，像是被人从里面用力撕开了一道口子，像是有什么东西要从那伤口处钻了出来。

“太白新生，助我剑胎！”
太白子身躯中，这道声音传出，金色符文抑制不住，从太白子体内弥漫而出。
天空中，一颗太白星若隐若现，一道星光从天降落，注入到太白子体内。
紧接着，太白子的身躯出现了一道道的裂痕，然后，从太白子体内，有一滴金色血液从眉心伤口中飞出，这滴金色血液像是精血的凝聚，而那血液中，还凝聚着一道身影，那身影仿佛是一柄宝剑化形。
“好手段！”
太鲲子开口，他盯着太白子那一滴金色血液。
那一金色血液在众人的注视下，竟然像是在演化生命一般，从胚胎到长出血肉，再到婴儿，小孩，最终，一个十八九岁的少年睁开了眼眸。
这个少年正是太白子的模样。
他每一根发丝都像是由剑意铸成，锋利无比。
他气息比之前更加可怕，此刻的他，真的像是一位少年神王。
“太白化凡术果然不凡，不愧是白帝的涅槃术……”
太鲲子轻声开口，太白子看了太鲲子一眼，轻轻的说道。
“道友，鲲皇的涅槃术传说可从虚无中化生，希望有一天可以见识一下！”
太鲲子点了点头，没有再说话。
现场很多人被太白子这样的手段惊到了。
太白子刚刚明明被重创，甚至有生命危险，但现如今竟然毫发无损，甚至比之前更加强大了。
这有些逆天无解了吧？
“极道经文不愧是凝聚了帝与皇的道果精华……”
黑暗中有不败主也不由轻声说道。
content_en:
"Is this the genius of the first ancestral land? It is indeed a genius born from the ancestral land. It is really terrifying to be able to smooth out the accumulated disparity of so many generations!"
The scene gradually turned from quiet to noisy. Taibaizi's fighting power made many people lose their minds, and Nie Ke's performance was even more shocking.
Especially the people from the Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny. At this moment, they vaguely understood why the extraterritorial forces that descended on the Nine Provinces, the Central Plains, and the Mythical World were suppressed by local forces.
Because the local genius here is indeed a bit evil.
Jiuzhou Tianxia is indeed the core place of the first ancestral land!
No wonder even Xuan Xiao had to retreat from the edge and come to the northern and southern worlds to compete with them for the territory of creation...
In the corner of the banquet, some of the undefeated masters looked inexplicably calm, while others had shocked expressions on their faces. It was obvious that this battle had caused ripples in their hearts.
"Taibaizi is very strong. Although he has only accumulated four lives, but with the killing power of his swordsmanship, he may be stronger than some undefeated masters who have accumulated five lives, but this Nie Ke is actually..."
One person spoke up and made this comment about this battle.
People looked around and saw that the one who spoke was the Son of God Jingxuan.
Qianyue nodded. There were five figures looming behind her. Each figure seemed to be condensed with a Dao Fruit. Against the backdrop of these five figures, Qianyue's figure became increasingly hazy and terrifying.
Some people speculated based on the five figures behind Qianyue that Qianyue was an undefeated master in five lifetimes, and now he is Qianyue's sixth lifetime.
Every figure behind her represents a lifetime, and once the five lifetimes merge into one, Qianyue's combat power will reach an unimaginable height.
But some people think that the origin of the Thousand Moon Goddess is more mysterious than imagined, because she knows many secrets and is like a walking ancient history.
Therefore, some people speculate that Qianyue may be undefeated for more than five lifetimes...
On the battlefield, people from Taibai Shenting also rushed to Taibaizi's side. There was a bloodstain between Taibaizi's eyebrows. His eyes were dim, but the vitality in his body had not completely disappeared.
"If it cannot be broken, it cannot be established. Let's use this to cut off this old shackles!"
There was a voice coming from Taibaizi's body.
This voice was not as peaceful as before, but full of sharp edge.
Immediately afterwards, in everyone's surprised eyes, Taibaizi's eyebrow wound seemed to have been torn open from the inside, as if something was about to come out of the wound.
"Taibai is reborn, help me with my sword fetus!"
This voice came out of Taibaizi's body, and the golden runes could not be restrained, and filled the air from Taibaizi's body.
In the sky, a Taibai star loomed, and a starlight fell from the sky and poured into Taibaizi's body.
Immediately afterwards, cracks appeared on Taibaizi's body, and then, from Taibaizi's body, a drop of golden blood flew out from the wound between the eyebrows. This drop of golden blood was like a condensed blood essence, and in the blood, there was also a figure condensed, and the figure seemed to be the shape of a sword.
"What a trick!"
Taikunzi spoke, and he stared at Taibaizi's drop of golden blood.
Under the gaze of everyone, the golden blood seemed to be evolving into life, from an embryo to growing flesh and blood, to an infant, to a child, and finally, an eighteen or nineteen-year-old boy opened his eyes.
This young man exactly looks like Taibaizi.
Every strand of his hair seemed to be made of sword intent, extremely sharp.
His aura was more terrifying than before. At this moment, he really looked like a young god king.
"Taibai's Mortal Transformation Technique is truly extraordinary. It is worthy of being the White Emperor's Nirvana Technique..."
Tai Kunzi spoke softly. Taibaizi glanced at Tai Kunzi and said softly.
"Fellow Taoist, the legend of Emperor Kun's Nirvana Technique can emerge from nothingness. I hope to see it one day!"
Tai Kunzi nodded and said no more.
Many people at the scene were shocked by Taibaizi's method.
tooBai Zi had been seriously injured just now, and his life was even in danger, but now he was unscathed and even stronger than before.
Isn't this a bit outrageous and unexplainable?
"The Jidao Scriptures truly embody the essence of the Emperor and the Emperor's Dao Fruit..."
There was an Invincible Lord in the darkness and he couldn't help but whisper.
